newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares continue fall in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares continue fall in quiet activity.

text.p: Egyptian share prices fell for the second day on Thursday in a quiet market dominated by closed deals in a bank and the takeover of a contracting firm.
The Capital Market Authority overall share index slipped 6.5 points to 353.08 in above-average volume of 123 million pounds ($36 million).
Trade worth 43.7 million pounds in Misr Exterior Bank and 36 million in Nasr Public Utilities and Installation accounted for most of that total.
Real estate Medinet Nasr Housing and Development said on Sunday it had bought 90 percent of Nasr Public Utilities for the 36 million pounds.
"It was very quiet today. Everyone is selling and there are no buyers in the market," said Ehab el-Mahellawi from Intercapital Brokerage.
"The market is falling because of the decline in mill prices. Investors have no trust in the sector, which is considered the thermometer of the stock market," he added.
Central and West Delta Flour Mills was the only mill that closed higher, up 1.5 pounds at 91 but the sector made overall poor volume.
The banking sector generated most trade in Thursday's market, with Alexandria Commercial and Maritime Bank leading the way, but most prices slipped anyway.
Shares worth 9.04 million pounds changed hands but the stock slipped 10.9 pounds to close at 206.6.
The Egyptian state has sold off 26.47 percent of the joint venture bank in April as part of its privatisation programme. The CMA said at the time the state had sold 300,000 shares at 301 pounds each.
Commercial International Bank (CIB) fell 3.52 pounds to 66.58 pounds after trading in 3.90 million pounds.
Mahellawy said investors were disappointed with the two pound dividend decided at the shareholders's annual general meeting on Thursday.

Misr International Bank/MIBANK closed four pounds higher at 609 after shares worth 2.19 million pounds changed hands and shares worth 1.70 million were traded in Egyptian American Bank but the stock slipped 6.5 pounds to 124.5.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 486.88 points from 503.6 points on Wednesday and the rarely-traded "closed" firms also slipped to 260.23 from 262.92 points.
Out of 89 shares traded, 14 rose and 46 fell while 29 ended unchanged.
